payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

fact.question: Is pencil-drawing treatment visibly present anywhere in the edited image?
fact.present_when: Visible pencil-like drawn strokes, hatching, or shading appear in at least some part of the image.
fact.absent_when: The image is clearly assessable and shows no visible pencil-drawing treatment.
fact.unknown_when: The image is too unclear to determine whether any pencil-drawing treatment is present.

response.content: {"status":"present","evidence":"The edited image has a muted, pencil-like appearance with visible sketchy strokes and shading across the food and surrounding objects."}
